svg.title: Fishing line unwinding from a rotating reel
svg.desc: A fishing reel rotates counterclockwise, unwinding line tangentially to the right from a radius r = 4.5 cm. Rotational quantities θ, ω, α describe the reel; linear quantities x, v, a describe the fishing line. The line speed is v = rω. An animated companion below illustrates the process; its complete static alternative is shown for reduced motion and print.

g.text: A pull on the line accelerates both the reel and the unwinding line
Line mark: x = rθ, v = rω, a = rα
t (s)
τ (mN m)
α (rad/s²)
ω (rad/s)
x (cm)
Constant pull torque: τ = T r = Iα
Radius 4.5 cm, I = 0.002 kg m², T = 0.040 N; starts at rest. Fixed radius, no slip or drag. Reel and
line share a distance scale. Pulling work becomes rotational kinetic energy.
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
